Mass holds the audience in rapt, forward-leaning attention.
It is a statement at the heart of this compelling and heartrending story of those trying to make sense of, come to terms with, and move on from the meaningless and inexplicable loss of a loved one.

Cracknell, fresh from her triumph with Arcadia at the Old Vic, marshals all of this with economy and precision, deftly introducing some unexpected catharsis and a glimpse of value, in this bleak encounter, for the young lad watching from the wings.
At its best, Mass is a mesmerising fusion of incisive writing and extraordinary performances.
